phyagleng brjod/'bel gtam dang klu gzhas sna tshogs 'di ni zlos gar dbu 'dzin sku ngo dngos grub lags nas ched bskul mdzad byung yang / phran chung dus nas rab byung bgyis khul gyis glu gzhas dang / zlos gar sogs la do snang dang sbyangs pa ye nas ma byas pas smyu gzhas gyi :rtsal dang / rnga rol/ skad gdangs/ dbyangs kyi nga ro sogs kyi zur cha tsam yang ma shes pas de lta bur yong thabs gtan nas med lugs zhus te khur len ma zhus kyang / yang bskyar gsungs don glu gzhas kyi tshig bzo gnang na skad gdangs dang dbyangs spi gyur khug sogs ci dgos khong tshos bzo chog lugs gsungs par brten/gzhon skyes rnam par mgu bar bya ba zhig bzo thub na dge mtshan 'dug snyam ste 1992 lo nas zhar dang zhor la mno bsam btang lte/ mi rigs dang lo rgyus kyi 'bel gtam/ sa gnas dang thon skyed kyi 'bel gtam / shes rig dang mi spyod kyi 'bel gtam sogs la sbyar te smyu gzhas kyi brtsam gzhi'i sa bon lta bu zhig 'bri rtsom dang le tshan khag so sor bzos te blo gsar mgu ba skyed pa'i yan lag tu 'grems spel zhu khul lags na/ le tshan cha tshang re nas blu len bya rgyu dka' yang so so'i dgos mkho dang mtsham pa'i tshig gnad 1
3khag bsgrugs rte glu gzhas sogs kyi gdangs snyan ci 'dra zhig len rgyu yod rung so sos rang mos gnang skyong / rtsom rig 'di dag shes rig yar rgyas kyi son rtsa lta bu yin na 'di las rgya bskyed de shes rig gi sgo 'phar rgya khyab tu phye thub pa'i smon 'dun dang bcas 'di'i deb grangs tshog stong lnga brgya tham pa dpar 'grems dang 'gro rgyun gzhan gyis phran la rogs phan dang / zhal 'debs ba455 ba 'dus gsog thog nas ched btang zhus pa lags na/skabs don 'brel yod khag la rin med dang de las gzhan pa rnams la dpar rin gyi thob cha zhu rgyu yin zhing / slad dpar 'debs kyi dbang tshad rigs slob yig tshang la yod pas de nas thag gcod bya rgyur bcas/ ci lte ming chig nor ba dang chad lhag sogs kyi chig skyon yod 3 so sos nor bcos mdzad de 'grel brjod gnang skyong dang / bkris bde legs bcas rigs slob 'gan 'dzin dge slong blo bzang rgya mtshos sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//2
r+p+parang rigs phu nu spro skyid 'phel ba'i gta75 〉phrugs 95sa bye brag blu gzhas sna tshogs/gzhan phan spyad pa'i 'bras bu'i mthar thug pa//gang gi mtshan tsam bzung yang legs tshogs gter//mnyam med sha kya'i rgyal po zhes grags par//sgo gsum gus pas rtag tu mchod par bgyi/ /kla klo'i mun smag gzhil ba'i me chen 'bar//kun yid skong ba'i bdud rtsi'i char chen 'bab/ /'tshe med zhi bas bdud dpung skyengs mdzad pa//ngo mtshar gangs can mgon po rgyal gyur cig/spros bral shel gyi lhun po'i mdzes sdug can//mtshan dpe rgyu skar tshogs kyi mdangs gsal bas//dpyod ldan kun gyi snying du bcud chags pa//3
4mtsho byung lha mo 'bral med bsnyen du rol//chos rig sbrang : 'tshol ba'i blo gsar tshogs//rnam dpyod gshog rtsal mkha' la 'phyo ba yis//gnas lnga'i nam 'phang gcod par spyan byed pa'i// shes rab mchog mthun dngos grub stsal tu gsol//gangs ri'i khrod du 'khrungs pa'i 'gro ba'i dpal//bcu phrag rig pa'i mkha' la sgyu 'phrul gar//lung rigs dbyar rnga sgrog la mnga' brnyes pa//mkhas grub g.yu 'brug tshogs la snying nas btud//gzhan bstun mkhas shing rnam dpyod yar 'gran can//kun la gnas skabs spro dgas sim pa dang //rim gyis mthar thug lam du bkri bya'i phyir/༈sna tshogs gtam gyi rgyu gzhas 'di na gsal//blo gsar sming la chags 'gyur ba'i//legs bshad gsar pa'i sbrang rtsi 'di//blo gsar kun la bgo bya yi//ma tshom spyod la dga' bar mdzod//zas kyis 'tsho skyong legs pa las/ /lang tsho rgyas pa ji lta bar//rig pa'i zas kyang de bzhin las/ /rig pa'i yon tan ches cher 'phel//4
5khams kyi zas rmu nyin re ste/ /rig pa'i zas sna mi 3 dang //chos kyi zas sna byang chub bar/ /'tsho ba so so'i byed las yin/:lus tshor bde ba mi las kyang / /dud 'gro lhag pa shin tu mang //yid tshor bde ba gtan chags pa/ /dgi bcu'i bya ba'i rjes su 'gro/mdor na bde :ga kun gyi gzhi/ /las 'bras gnas sna mthar thug pa//shin tu lkog gyur de ltar yang / dan sdig so sor mi ba smyu bas//'bras bu mi bslu thog babs sna/ /kun gyis mngon sum spyod la ltos//mi spyod 'dra yang so so yis/ rlud :ga myong ba so so dang /༈skad cig tsam yang dal med par /dpal dang 'byor pa sgrub pa dang //lce brgya bskyod pa'i gtam dag gis/ /bde ba g.yab mo bgyis pas kyang //rkyen ngan thog tu babs pa na/ /de dag kun gyis ci phan ltos//gso rig mkhas pa'i dregs ldan dag /nad kyis rang thog zin pa nasma sbyangs ba dang khyad med las/ /nad kyis dmigs bsal mthong ngam cisstobs dang srid sogs la dbang ba'i/ /'jig rten 'di na dregs can dag/can ngan thog tu bab tsa na/ /sung mkhan 'bum dang 'tsho byed 'bum//mthun rkyen ri bo ltar bgyil kyang / /de dag kun gyis ci phan ltos//can ngan ra thog ma bab dbam /gcig las gcig 'byon gcig mkhas 'gran//'chi rkyen rang thog bab tsa na/ /yang bran tshud pa'i rmo rmo dang /༈pho brang cer bzhugs brjod nyams can/ /nus pa 'gran la khyad par ltos//gang yang ma bslab gan rdzi dang / /gnas lnga rig pa'i paṇa〉 ta //5
6rkyen ngan rang tho4 babs tsa na/ /bzlog par rigs pa su sno ltos//'dzam gling gang ba'i nor bdag dang / /nyin re'i las kyis 'tsho ba dag/'chi ba'i g.yab mo thog bab 3/ /bsnam rgyu /'ad par ci 'dug ltos//de dag kun la gang spyad kyang / /'jig rten bya bzhag thams cad kyis//tha mar rang phung khon ra zad/ /de bas rang gi bya ba dag/dka' yang dgi rig las 'bras dang / /mi 'gal ji tsam legs bslabs pa /de tsam 'di phyi'i bde dga'i gnas/ /khyad 'phags 'gyur ba lung dag dang //dpe dang rigs pa mtha' yas grub/ /lung rigs rjes su 'brang ba yis//bya ba dag la dpyod shes pa/ /rnam dpyod can du kun gyis bsngags//de las ldog ste gya tshom du/ /sgrub sgrub smra smra mang na yang //klad pa rul ba'i mi gzugs las/ /mi yi bya ba sgrub nus min//de bas chos dang rig pa'i nor/ /ci thub bsgrub la 'bad par 'tshal//'dir 'phros don smras pa/mi yi rnam dpyod 'phel rim mtha' med par//de dang 'tshams pa'i snyan ngag smra bar yang //zab dang rgya che'i tshul lugs dang sbyar te/ ༈mgu ba sbyin par snyan rtsom mi zad pa//'dzam gling khyon la khyab pa gsal bzhin du//la las snyan ngag gsar pa ngom ngom gyis//rmig chu'i nang du rgya mtsho bsdu dgos zhes/ /6
7sgrog gtam spel ba dgod bro de lhag ci//sprang po za lhag bzas pas rgyags gtam bzhin//blo dman kho nar mkho ba 'ga' tsam gyis//thams cad nged kyis byas so snyam sems te//4 gis byas pa kho nar skyon med dang //gzhan kun skyon du bltas pas khrag 'khrugs kyis//thams cad khrag tu mthong bar shin tu skyo//tsi tsi'i khung bur dom rgan mi tsud cing //lug rgyas g.yug bkag mi thub 'phel rim las//blo gros rab 'bring tha gsum la gzhigs pas//rnam dpyod sno brgyar 'byed phyir gtam tshogs smra//
8shes rig ngos 'dzin gyi 'bel gtam/spyir shes rig ces pa sgra bshad kyi dbang du byas na shes pa dang rig pa zhes pa tsam las ma thon pas/ shes pa dang rig pa ni don gcig cing/de ni sems ldan thams cad la yod pas ngo mtshar mi che yang / sgra 'jug gi dbang du byas na/ rang gi rnam dpyod gong nas gong 'phel bya ba'am rnam dpyod rang dbang du dpyod shes pa la shes rig du bzung bas 'di ni shin tu rgya che la gting zab pa zhig la 'jug pa yin/ de yang shes rig sbyong zhes pa'i che rang gi rnam dpyod dong nas gong 'phel bya ba la zer zhing / shes rig dang ldan pa zhes pa'i 3 legs nyes sam blang dor la rang dbang du dpyod shes pa la 'jug cing / rig gzhung zhes pa'i che de dag rgyun 'dzin bya ba'i gzhung lugs rnams la 'jug pa yin/ rgya che ba ji ltar yin zhes na/ 'gro ba mi'i rigs la med mi rung ba'i 'tsho rten yin pa'i gnad kyis yin/ spyir 'tsho ba la zang zing gi 'tsho ba/ rig pa'i 'tsho ba sī shes rig gi 'tsho ba/chos kyi 'tsho ba gsum yod pas/ zang zing gi 'tsho ba zhi gtso bo lus 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen zhig yin la/ 'di ni sems can dud 'gro rnams dang thun mong ba'i 'tsho ba yin pas 'gro ba mi'i sgos chos shig ma yin/ shes rig dang chos kyi 'tsho ba ni gtso bo sems 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen zhig yin pas/ mi dang 8
9lha'i rigs la khyad par du 'phags pa'i sgos chos shig yin zhing / mi la rnam dpyod kyi lta ba zhig yod na de la shes rig gi 'tsho ba med mi rung ba yin/rang nyid phugs kyi mdun ma la dpyod shes pa zhig yin na chos kyi 'tsho ba med mi rung ba yin/ gal te shes rig gi 'tsho ba tshad longs shig med na/rnam dpyod can la 'dod pa dgang ba'i thabs med pag so so'i 'dod pa ma gang ba de srid du yid kyi sdug bsngal rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba yin/ gal te chos kyi 'tsho ba tshad longs shig med na so sos phugs don la lta ba'i che re ba bca' ba'i gnad med pas stong pa zhig tu gyur nas yid kyi g.yang sar 'grim pa lta bur mthong bas bde ba'i rten mi rnyed do/ des na 'gro ba mi'i 'dod pa ni rgya shin tu che la mtha' med pa yin pas shes rig kyang de dang 'tsham pa'i rgya che la mtha' med pa yin/ de'i phyir shes rig gi mtha' gtugs par dka' bas na gting shin tu zab pa'ang yin no/ chos kyi 'tsho ba'ang rnam pa mi 'dra ba ji snod cig yod mod nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i chos kyi 'tsho ba ni shes rig gi 'tsho ba'i 'byung khungs yin pas shes rig las kyang rgya che zhing gting zab pa/ 'gro ba mi'i spyi tshogs shig chags phyin chad de lta bu'i shes rig dang chos kyi 'tsho ba phun sum tshogs pa zhig med na ni mi rigs spi bde skyid dgos mkho tshang ba mi 'byung ba ma zad/ sger so so la'ang de bzhin mi 'byung ngo / zang zing gi 'tsho ba tsam ke dbyings zhugs pa ni bsam pa'i 'khyer se dud 'gro las khyad par 'phags chos gang yang med pas bsam blo 9
7༷ma btang na ma gtogs btang na yid 'tsho ba'i rten mi rnyed pas sems spre ngal ba rgyun mi chad do/ de yang shes rig gi 'tsho ba rten gzhir byas nas chos kyi 'tsho ba dngos gzhi bslang dgos pas thog mar gal che ba sna shes rig gi 'tsho ba yin no/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ni gtso bo sems ma btul ba gdul bar bya ba dang / 'dul ba rnams smin par bya ba dang / smin pa rnam dgrol bar gyab kho na yin pas/ nyi ma'i 'od zer bzhin du 'gro ba mi rigs spyi'i 'tsho ba thun mong ba yin 6/ slob dpon a r+ya de bas / bzhi brgya pa rab byed bcu gnyis pa las/ rigs pa'i don ni gzhan las kyang / blo ldan legs pa 'dod pas blang / nyi ma sa steng mig ldan la/ kun gyi spyi mthun ma yin nam/ zhes gsungs pa ltar yin no/ 'on kyang bod pas 'dzin pa'i sangs rgyas kyi chos la bod kyi chos zhes btags pa ni/ dus phyis 'dzin pa po'i gtso bo bod pa yin pas de'i cha nas btags pa tsam yin gyi/ lung tshan dang mi rigs 'dra min ci 'dra zhig gis spyod kyang 'os shing 'tsham pa'o/shes rig ni 'gro ba mi rigs thun mong ba dang thun mong min pa gnyis su yod cing / bye brag bod la mtshon na'ang gnyis su yod pas dang po na/ bod kyi yul chos dang 'brel ba'i chos 'byung/ rgyal rabs / gtam rgyud/ sgyu rtsal / zlos gas gshis spyod dang 'phrod bsten gyi rnam gzhag bzo rigkhrims lugs / chab srid dang skad yig gi rnam gzhag sogs yin no/'di dag bod pa'i thun min gyi shes rig yin pas/ bod rigs so sos 0
77'gan 'khur blangs te 'dzin dgos shing / bye brag tu slob grwa khag tu dge slob gnyi gas khur du ma song bar rgyan du len thub pa zhig cis kyang dgos so/gnyis pa ni spyir mi'i gshis spyod dang 'brel ba'i ya rabs kyi lta spyod dang /'phrod bsten / khrims lugs/ phyi'i tshan rig/ nang gi bsam blo'i tshan rig spyi tshogs kyi las don dang srid lugs kyi lta grub sogs su sbyar ba'i rig gzhung dang de dag yul du byed pa'i shes rig dag ni thun mong ba'i shes rig yin pas/ rang nyid 'gro ba mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas de dag la gang thub ci thub kyi nus pa bton te sbyong brtson dgos pa ni shes rig yar rgyas kyi lam du zhugs pa rnams la med mi rung ngo/ /rang gi rig gzhung dran bskul/gangs ljongs mi rigs yongs kyis thugs snang chen po gnang dgos pa nga tsho 'gro ba mi zhig yin pa'i cha nas mi rigs so so'i shes yon dang rig gzhung la gces spras chen pos gsan bsam dang sgrub pa gong 'phel gtong dgos/ de yang mi rigs so so'i shes yon spel na/ so so'i gzhung shugs kyis 'phel zhing / so so'i rig gzhung ji tsam spel bas/ so so'i shes yon shugs gyis 'phel yang / de gnyis gang rung gcig nyams dmas su song na gnyi ga'ang nyams dmas su 'gro ba ni/ mi'i lus srog gnyis lta bu yin na/de gnyis lda ma sprul bar gsog srung spel gsum dgos/ gang yin zhe na/11
74mi rigs so so'i 'byed chos kyi gtso bo ni/ mi rigs so so'i yul goms gshis spyod dang khrims lugs sogs yin la/ 'di dag gi 'byung khungs smru/mi rigs so so'i shes yon dang rig gzhung la thug cing / rig gzhung dang shes yon bzang na/ yul goms gshis spyod sogs kyang rje bzang du 'gro zhing /de nyid ngan na yul goms gshis lugs sogs kyang je ngan rje sdug tu 'gyur ba dang / rig gzhung dang shes yon phyug na/ mi rigs kyang phyug tu 'gro/yang de dag dbul na mi rigs kyang dbul phongs su 'gyur/ rig gzhung dang shes yon tshad mthor song na/ mi rigs kyang tshad mthor 'gro ba dang / de gnyis ji tsam khyab che ba de tsam du mi rigs kyi dbang tshad khyab cher 'gro ba sogs mdor na/ mi rigs kyi gong bu dam lhod dang stobs shugs 'phel 'grib gang cir/ so so'i rig gzhung dang shes yon 'phel 'grib la rag lus pa ni/ mkhyen ldan rnam pas mkhyen gsal ltar dang lhag par rang cad kha ba ri pa'i rig gzhung ni/ ston pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa mdo sngags rig gnas dang bcas pa tshang la ma nor ba dang / zab pa dang rgya che ba de nyid dang 'dres shing / de nyid las mchod cing dar rgyas song ba yin zhing / de yang mi lo stong phrag brgal ba'i gong rol nas dar zhing rgyas la ma nyams pa 'di nyid yin la 'di yang kun la 'tshe ba spong ba'i snying rje'i rtsa ba can dang / 'gro ba yongs kyi phan bde'i 'byung khungs/ mchog dman thams cad kyi 3 ba skong ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu/ ma rig pa'i mun pa sel ba'i nyi ma/ nyon mongs kyi tsha gdung skyob pa'i nya rgyas/ dug gsum nad kun zhi ba'i sman 12
7〉mchog rlabs chen gzhan don bsgrub pa'i cha rkyen/ ris med thar bgrod pa'i gru gzings sogs mdor na gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi dgos mkho yongs su tshang la bla na ma mchis pa yin na/ de ltar shes shing bkrin dran pa'i sgo nas dad sdus dang spro ba 'gog med du shar te/ rang gi rig gzhung rang gi mig 'bras ltar gces spras zab mos brtson pa dang 'dzin skyong spel gsum gang sa nas 'bad 'bungs lhod med yong bar bod rigs yin no cog gi thugs la 'jags par 'tshal//byis pa'i mgu blu/rang cag rigs sras khyung phrug pho mo rnam pa//rang nyid skyes tsam nyid nas rang rang gi rigs la mched pa'i chos srid kyi gzu1ga lho ldan pas/ rigs gzhan 'dab chags kun las khyad par 'phags pa bzhin/ rang rang 'tshar long dang lhan cig chos rig gi gshog rtsal rgyas/shes brtson 9 dpa' rtsal rig gzhung gi gnam 'phang gcod de/ tshur rgol 'dab chags tshogs kun rnam par gnon/ mi rigs kyi khe dbang bsgrub ste chos srid kyi mnga' thang phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba dang / rang mgon bla na med pa'i dgongs bzhed bsgrub pa'i sming stobs dgung la reg pa'i dga' ston phyogs kun khyab gyur cig lhag bsam zla ba'i 'od snang thugs la bcang bar 'tshal 3
14rigs kyi zhen bskul glu gzhas/nga tsho bod kyi rigs ni/ /'jig rten gzhan dang mi 'dra//'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs gyi/ /thugs rje'i 'phrul las byung yod//longs spyod 'bru rigs dag kyang / /phyag na pa dras btab ste//rin chen gter kha mtha' yas/ /sa gzhir byin rlabs mdzad yod//de mthus sangs rgyas bstan pa/ /yongs rdzogs bod pas 'dzin te//dge 'dun 'dus pa che zhing / /mkhas dang grub pa'i khyu mchognam mkha'i skar tshogs lta bur/ /mi lo chig stong brgal bar//lham mer gsal bzhin bzhugs yod/ /zhi bde'i dpal gyi 'byung khungs//rigs pa'i gzhung lugs phyi mo/ /zab rgyas 'gran zla bral ba//kha ba can pa'i gan mdzod/ /khyad par deng gi 'dzam gling //kun la zhi bde sbyin te/ /chos med kla klo'i lta spyod//lhag med chos su bsgyur yod/ /rigs kyi myu gu rnam pas//rang rang rigs dang mthun pa'i/ /lta spyod bsres lhad med par//rig kye bya ba sgrub 'tshal/ /rigs las skyes pa'i 'gan srung //rigs can rnams kyis bzhes dgos/ /skyes pa'i myu gu gang yin//sa bon de dang mthun par/ /'bras bu smin pa dgos bzhin//rigs bzang rigs las skyes pa'i/ /rigs kyi me tog rab rgyas/rigs mthun 'bras bu 'byin par/ /lhag bsam do khrab bsgo mdzod//khu

48kyang / sems ni ches cher rgod pa mang / rigs rtsal rgod pos mkhas snyan yang / sems rgyud ches cher bsnyems pa mang / rta rgod srab kyis ma btul bar/ de la bzhon rnams ya yo che/ mi cad khrims kyis ma btul bas blos 'gel grogs su 'gyur ba dka'/ dge sdig las 'bras gnas yangs la/zhib tu sbyangs na ma btul yang / ngang gis 'dul ba de yi gshis/ de bzhin dbu ma'i lta ba der/ go ba gnad du song gyur na/ nyon mongs 'dul bar dpa' ba dang / srid pa'i phun tshogs gang la yang / yid smon dor nas skyo shas 'phel/ thar pa'i yon tan ngang gis 'dus/ byams dang snyeng rje byang chub sems/ rim gyis sbyangs nas mthu brtas na/ ched du ma btul legs 'dul tshe gzhan bde bsgrub par dpa' bo 'thob/ sems 'dul bal mi 'pho ba'i/shes bya rig pa'i gnas yangs la/ sbyangs pa mar+sā par song gyur kyang / shed nyams rgyas pa'i seng chen bzhin/ dman pa brtse gdung nyams pa'i rgyu/sems dul ba yi man ngag dang / shes bya'i rig pa zung 'brel du/ sbyangs pa ji tsam mthor song na/ de tsam rang gzhan gnyis phan ) mi yi khyu mchog don ldan 'gyus mkhas dang btsun pa'i yon tan gnyis/ zung du ma 'brel mkhas 'khur can/ spyi tshogs nang gi gshed ma ste/ phan las gnod 'gyur che bar srid/ bzang po'i yon tan dman gyur na/ mkhas btsun yon tan stobs che yang / cher ma'i sdong po ji bzhin rte/ ring na mdzes kyang gtugs na rtsub/ de bas mkhas btsun bzang gsum gyi/ yon tan lhan cig sbyong bar rigs//

5drubrten du bkur to/ brjod pa'i rgan rabs gtsos byas/ 'dus pa'i pho mo'i tshogs la/ skal bzang dga' ston rtsa bar/ ci 'dod rol bar 'tshal lo/pho gzhon tshos lan/'bru bcud stong gis sbyar ba'i/ dwangs ba'i btung ba rgya mtsho/ rtsa gsum 'dus pa'i lha tshogs/ dgyes par mchod sprin btegs shing / sa la dbang ba'i sa skyong / 'khor bcas sri zhur dbul lo/ ce dga' lhan cig 'grogs pa'i/ bgres gzhon bar gsum yongs la/ ci 'dod bsnyen du bkur nas/dga' sems 'khol ba'i ngang nas/ thugs la tshim par mdzod cig 'on tang btung ba thal te/ mang po gtam gyi gzhi bslang / lus 'dar sems rgyud 'khrul nag 'dod pa'i bde ba brel 'tshubs/ bag yod gnas dang bral yong/mo gzhon tshos/gzhon yang sems pa brtan pas/ sems kyi brtan pa g.yo bar/ btung ba tsam gyis ci byed/ don gnyis 'bras bu bsgrub par/ re pa don ldan 'gyur na/yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog kyang / las gsod mthun pa'i dbang red/yang pho gzhon tshos smra pa/bkris rtags brgyad bkra ba'i/ gser gyi dkar gzhong nang du/ ro brgya bcud kyi phul byung / zas sna bco brgyad bsgrags pa/ mchog gsum rgyal brgya mtshor/ mnyes par sprin phung brtags nas/ chos dang srid kyi lam ston/skyabs gnas dge ba'i bshes dang / rgyal blon 'khor bcas 'du sar bza'60
lta1bca'i bdud cu'i rgya mtsho/ ci bder rim par 'bul lo/ pad+mar bung ba 'dus bzhin/ skal bzang dus la byon pa/ dgyes par bskang ba'i bsnyen bkur/ spro ba bsrings nas bzhes mdzod/ mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod bzhin/ci 'dod bzhis par 'tshal lo/ gral mgo yar la mjal dang / brjod nyams stong gi rang bzhin/ srid pa'i g.yang du chags pa/ rin thang bral ba'i gzab mchor/ seng chen sgeg nyams ngom bzhin/ legs bshad zlu yi rang bzhin/snyan 'jebs sdir sdir sgrogs pa/ gus cag mig gi bdud rtsi/ skal bzang dga' ston thob byung / bar du lang tsho dar 'bab/ rma byas gar la rol bzhin/pho rtsal seng phrug gar rol/ mo rtsal 'brug gi 'khug 'gros/ phan tshun yid la 'phreng bar/ gcig sems gcig gis 'phrogs song / gzab mchor wa mo 'gros ldan/ rnam sras phu nu'i tshogs bzhin/ dus tshod gar 'gro mi shes/'dus sar ci bder rol pag mi che'i bya ba brjed song / gral smad phu nu'i tshogs rnams/ rigs kyi myu gu gsar pa/ skal bzang me tog bkra ba/ lang tsho lta na 6ga pa/ kun yid bskang ba'i dga' ston/ rgan gzhon bar gsum 'du ba'i/ chos dang srid kyi dpal 'bas sbyor ba phun sum tshogs pa/ chos srid las kyi 'khor lo/ skal bzang 'di lhag ci yod/ dga' dad spro gsum 'phel bas/ ngo mtshar bas kyang ngo mtshar/༈bu mo zhig gi gzhas/yar song yar la phyin pas/ yar stod sprug la dkar pos/ dgyes pa'i 61
ldan'dzum zhal bstan nas/ khyed rang byon pa legs so/ mdzes pa'i lang tsho dar ba/ bsod nams dge ba'i mthu yin/ ga nas ga la song yang / gzhan gyi yid dbang 'phrog yong / sngon yang dkon mchog mchod nas/ da yang dkon mchog mchod cig sngon mang bsod nams bsags pas/ da yang bsod nams gsog mdzod/ sngon yang sdig pa spangs nas/ da yang sdig pa spongs shig gzhan la phan pa'i las ni/ chung yang 'bad pas sgrubs shig gzhan la gnod pa'i las ni/ chung yang rtag tu gos shig gsungs pa yid la bcags pas/ spang blang 'gal med zhus yod/ mar song mar la phyin pag mar gyi mtsho chen nang nas/ nya mo gser mig dgu pas/ che sngon legs par bsgrubs pas mi la lha yi kyus sdug bu mo khyed la byung 'dug 3 sngon bslabs la ma nyan/ da lta dud 'gror skyes pa/ nya mo nga yi sdug bsngal/ lan gcig gsan pa gnang dang / dngas ma'i mtsho ru gnas bca'/ bltas na skyed nyams kha yang /gcig za gcig gi dngangs skrag sems la rgyun chad mi 'dugdbyar dus rgya mtsho rlog par gyur pa na/ rang la long ba bzhin du gang la yang / ci bya gtol bral zas kyang rnyed par dku'/ kho ru chu rtsod song nas zug gzer dang / dgun dus 'khyags pa'i lugs su tshud nas ni/ mun khong bcug pa'i btson pa ji bzhin 'gyur/ bde skyid tshor ba dpyid dus tsam zhig yin/ de bas mi yi bde skyid chos shes kyis/ phugs kyi bde don 'tshol bar lhur len mdzod/ sdug la :ga gi ngo sprod ma byung bar/ skyid la skyid por ngo shes ga nas 52
58skye/ bzang ngan de dag las 'bras mi bslu bas/ 'byung bar shes nas las la spang blang mdzod/ ces pa'i gdams ngag bzang po zhig phran la thob pa de yis kyang / bya ba gang la bad yod kyis/ don ldan bya ba ngang gis 'phel/nags dang spang gi mtshams su/ lha bya gong mo mjal byung / khong gis nga la gsungs don/ so so'i 'dod pa gang shar/ lag tu blang cas ma byos/rang la dgos pa'i don rnams/ legs par brtags nas bsgrub dgos/ ma brtags hab rgyug che na/ skyon chag rang thog phog yong / grogs la 'dris par ma pa 'dris nas phyi thag ma thung / rang la zhe nas gnod pa/ chang rag tha mag sogs la/ rtag tu 'jems cha dgos shing / yon tan bslab pa'i dus su/g.yeng ba spangs nas sgrubs shig sbyangs 'bras thon pa'i dus su/ las 'gan gtsang ma sgrubs shig khas len sla chos ma byed/ blangs pa don 'khyol byed dgos/ nyen dogs che ba'i don rnams/ gsang nas bsgrub dgos bden yang /de las gzhan pa'i las don/ gsong por smras nas bsgrab na/ phan tshun las bde byed bde/ yid ches 'phel ba'i gnas yin/ zhes pa'i bka' slob thob byung / bka' slob lag len bltar bas/ don chen ngang gis 'phel song mi la slob gso da nas shing / slob gso lag len bltar dgos/ mi che'i mdun lam ring po/ mthar zug sangs rgyas na 'phang / chos srid gnyis spi rnam 'gros/ cang shes rta bzhin bskyod de / thabs shes gnyis spi lam tsugs/dus dang 'tshams par bsgrub na/ chos ldan zhing du skye ba'i/ skal ldan mi yi go 63
54chod/ blo rgya ha cang chung bas/ srid lugs kho nar bskyod nas/ mkhas pa'i 'gying nyams che ba/ mkhas pa'i gsob kyi rang bzhin/ btsal na snying pos stongs pas/ sming po yod mdog ma byos/ 'phral phugs rgyang gsum la brten/legs nyes dpyod par nus na/ 'gro ba mi yi rnam dpyod/ rnam dpyod don go chod yod/ blo dang rigs pa yod na/ lam lugs de nyid tshol zhig lus spyod dul la bzang ba/ zhal nas legs bshad snyan snyan/ yid la rnam dpyod bkra ba/phun sum tshogs pa'i yon tan/ yar thon yar 'dren byed pa/ yar thon can gyi mi yin/ mar thon mar 'then dbye ba/ dpyod shes spang blang shes dgos//pho mo phan tshun bgying ba'i tshig gshags/pho gzhon tshos smras pa/ya gi'i spang gi dkyil du/ sha ba bu mo'i skyid mdog sgeg pa'i lus rtsal 'khug bzhin/ yar rgyug mar rgyug byed gas/ skyid pa'i nyams snang ma red/ pho chen grogs dang bral nas/ zhed snang skyes pa yin 'dugmo gzhon tshos smras pa/pha gi'i cher gseb nang du/ gzig pho rdzig nyams che ba/ kha gdangs mche ba btsigs nas/ ri bong bzhin du bsdad 'dug sang stobs 'bar ba ma red/zu gsum zan dang bral nas/ bkres ltogs che ba yin 'dug yang pho gzhon
ltaltatshos zhing kha'i zur nas rgyu ba/ bu mo zor ba snom mkhan/ zhing las grung mdog kha po/ g.yas 'khyor g.yon 'khyor byas te/ dom gsum phar la spos nas/ rnam gcig phyir 'gros byed gas/ chang gis myos pa ma red/ chung 'dris rgyab nas yong bas/ mthong nas sems pa 'khrugs 'dugbu mo tshos/cher ma'i sdong po'i 'khris su/ zhi mi brjod nyams can de/ nyin gang tsi tsi bsgugs kyang / ma brnyes gnyid la shor 'dug tha na gnyid lam nang du/ tsi tsi za 'dod byed gas/ nyin mtshan dbye ba med par/ nyal na tsi tsi i khu tsi tsi lag tu zin par/ rang la lus rtsal dgos red/pho gzhon tshos/'khri shing ga 'on nu rgyas par/ brtan pa'i sdong po gzhan la/ 'khris nas 'phel tshad rdzogs par/ 'gyur bas yid smon che ba/ brten sa gzhan dang bral na/ kun gyis gnas nas bton yong / me tog pad+ma dkar po/ mtshonas skyes shing rgyas kyang / rang gi zhal kha phye bar/ nyi ma'i zer la brten dgog me tog ba sdu la ni/ skyes pa dar ma zhig gis/ chang gis kha 'phros btang na/yongs su rgyas pa'i mdzes khyad/ phun sum tshogs pa 'byung yang / de las ldog na rang nyid/ me tog phal pa'i rang mtshang / rang dbang rang gis spyod 'dod/kun la mtshungs par yod kyang / gzhan bsnyen gzhan dbang kho na/ khams gsum 'khor ba'i rang gshis/bu mo zhig gis/ yo

lta7mjug ma gzhan las thung ba/ mi la'ang de bzhin 'gyur na/ yid 'phrog bya yul sus rnyed/bu mos der lan/sha pho rwa co bzang bas rang :ga rgyu/ gla pho gla rtsi smin pas rang srog shor/don gyi ro bcud bzang ngan ma dpyad par/ mig sngar kha dog mdzes min rjes 'brangs ngan/ dug gi me tog zas su spyod gyur ram/ ngo tsha khril yod lus kyi 'khri shing mdzes/ ya rabs khrims kyi yal ga rab rgyas shing/ shes yon rnyiXpa bu g.yur du za ba de/ 'di phyi gnyis kyi las don de nyid bzang / bus kun gyis zhal nas bsgrags pa'i ya rabs dang / ngo tsha phyo yod mkha' la gzhu ris bzhin/ ngo thog don la dbab na de las ldog ga gding mtshungs pa rnyed rgyu shin tu dka'/yang bu mos lan/dka' yang rang la dgos pa'i nan/ ngal ba ma 'dzems rang lag tu/son thabs bgyis pa shin tu gcig rnyed dka' bsam nas bor gyur na/ mi go chod pa'i las don shor/yang bus smras pa/ye ma de 'dra'i sems shugs/ brten na bden don mtha' dag mi 'grub ci la srid dam/ rgyal sras byang chub sems dpas/ lus srog 'dzems pa 67
58med par/ gzhan don sgrub pa los bden/ yang bu mos smras pa/ mi la lhag bsam dgos red/ lhag bsam nor sar ma skyed/ gtam la bden pa dgos red/ bden pa smra mkhas nga gos red/ las la lhar brtson dgos red/ lhar brtson ngo lkog spongs shig mdza' 'dris hub rgyug ma byos/ 'dris nas phyi thag ring zhing / drang bden mthar 'khyol thub dgos/ zugs la 'jigs pa gnang dang zhes pa'o//rtsal 'gran glu gzhas/bu'i gzhas/ dbyar gyi kham sdong sgang la/ bye'u chos sna sna tshogs / me tog bcud kyis brgyags pas/ blta na spya mdog mdzes pa/ nyan na gsung skad snyan pa/ blta bas ngoms pa med pa/ yid dbang de yis 'phrogs song / bu mo'i gzhas/ mthong tshul de tsam gyis nas/ mgu zhing chim par gyur na/ chos srid bya ba gang gis/ mi mgu'i gnas de gnang yod/ ya gi'i spang la ltos dang/ ri dwags 6shug du mas/ ci bder zas kyis brgyags nas/ zag pa'i lus rtsal 'khyug bzhin/ rigs rgyud spel ba'i don du/ dga' dgur 'dod pa spyod ltar/mi rigs bzang po spel bar/ snga rabs lugs srol bzang por/ khrims dang mthun par spyod dgos/ chom rkun bya ba bzhin du/ klad chung las de spongs shigbus tshos/ pad+ma'i me tog mdzes pas/ yid dbang dbang med 'phrogs nas/sdong po'i reg bya nub pos/ gnod kyang tshor ba mi 'dug thugs rgyud bzang ba'i dbang gis/ zhal nas gshe gshe yang yang / sems la na tsha med par/58
